Ya'll... My primary product at work has over 1100 feature branches till open in the git repo.

A bunch of those have _probably_ been merged into `master/main` but... We never deleted the original.

...

Can you all work in this kind of chaos? I ask because I genuinely struggle. Like I can't think with this kind of _overhead_. I can _ignore_ it but I can _do_ anything with it prior to sorting it.

Would love to hear thoughts or feelings about it. <3
